  // Click to play: the YouTube player only loads when someone presses play.
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest('.vthumb'); if (!b) return;
    var f = document.createElement('iframe');
    f.src = 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/' + b.dataset.id + '?autoplay=1&rel=0';
    f.title = b.dataset.title; f.allow = 'autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen'; f.allowFullscreen = true;
    b.replaceWith(f);
  });
</script>
